title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
slides: Can AI really fix drug development's failure rate?
Proximal Ventures just raised its debut fund for this
It bets on AI startups, not traditional biotech labs
Founders pitching drug-AI startups now have a new check
Test one AI drug tool before competitors do
thread_text:
1. Drug development is broken

Nine out of ten drugs fail in clinical trials. Proximal Ventures just raised its debut fund to bet on AI startups that could fix that.

2. Not another biotech fund

This new fund only backs AI startups, not traditional biotech labs. It's a direct challenge to how drugs have always been developed.

3. Founders get a new check

If you're pitching a drug-AI startup, there's fresh capital available now. Proximal Ventures is ready to write the first check.

4. Test before you commit

Before you trust any AI drug tool, run it against a known benchmark. Competitors won't wait for you to catch up.

5. What's your move?

If you had access to a drug-AI tool today, what would you test first? Try one prompt on a public dataset and see for yourself.
